The complete three-interval sweep found nothing above even the original seed, so normalized unions of three dense intervals in `[0,48]` are refuted. Generic local methods repeatedly converge to `sol_0001`, while dense-core variants underperform, pointing toward structured digit constructions with controlled sum/difference collisions.
